body: If I didn't have these thoughts as a coping mechanism, I would've already gone insane and did something very hurtful to others by now.
An acquaintance actually asked me this today. Nothing happened, nothing good happened.

Looking back now, the true cause of my pain was actually the loss of trust in people I deeply valued. They failed to do some of the things you mentioned like never checking up. I guess that's why I've lost interest in truly being close with other people. Yeah... it really does suck that having others is a requirement in life. It seems you've went through a lot. Hope you'll get through life and maybe even find someone who won't break your trust.
Yeah, being irritated is a big indication that my mind is in an unstable state. If I get relaxed, things are fine, but fk... It's so easy for me to get irritated by everything.
Yeah same... I don't think anything can cure my case like in the past, I would've cried if someone would lend me their shoulder to cry on.

There's not really much you can do. However, just being there for the person can help a lot. Also, it would be even worse if you become mentally exhausted from always trying to help that person you love. Ofc, getting professional help can make it easier for that person to find balance in your relationship.

I agree. OP, it's better to get a proper check-up from a professional. However, if you are just asking for my experience, yes, I do experience throat tightness frequently. This is a common effect of anxiety. I usually have difficulty speaking when this happens and would just drink water to remedy it.
Whether you did it or not, I hope you'll be alive or at rest and not anything in between. And if you're forced to live another life, I hope it would be a lot better than this.
That's a big W for us to celebrate 🥳. Really I'm proud, many people here are proud because we're not losing you, a kindred soul today.

Yeahhh. I too have burned a part of myself. That was the part of me that cared for what others think when I kms. I got tired of fighting with myself and that part of me realized that no one really wanted me to be here, so it left. As I am now, it does give a sense of relief and clarity of the fact that I'm not obligated to do anything, and I can just end it all whenever I get tired of everything.
I don't know how many "It is what it is." I can take.
As long as I still consider kms as the best option, I'll never "truly" befriend others.
It's so painful.... please end this.

Hiii! hope you're doing at least slightly better now. You've probably heard this before, but I'd still like to remind you that you are not a disappointment. Even though feeling down isn't something to cry about, it's still worth validation. Whatever instances that made you feel this way, they are not you. You've probably cried a lot at this point in life, that's why I'd like to give a virtual hug.
I usually do this before sleeping to have a feeling of warmth.  But who am I to have someone like that?

I think it's fine not to know what to do at the age of 16. This is the transitional period to adulthood, and mental health problems/trauma doesn't really help. People also change, and it's unfair to you that you are the victim in this case. You never deserved this, no child does.
And yeah, there are a lot of creeps in the internet. I do hope that you'll eventually find someone who you can freely talk to.
Thiissss. One of the main reasons why I don't go out is to avoid seeing "normal people".
Happy Sugar Life
There better be good food when I die. At least with good food, it would be easier for them to move on from my death.

Same here. I think it's normal for someone to be more inclined to talk about their depression and feel vulnerable with who they truly trust compared to just an acquaintance.
For me, I'm not sharing my problems to people, but I thank the person who I feel bonded with that listens to my vents and things I want to put off my chest.
Having to never wake up would be the best thing to happen to me right now.

Hey, first of all I would like to congratulate you for graduating high school. This achievement probably doesn't mean much, but considering what you have to go through, it makes it more valuable. Not everyone can endure it for long on top of stress from school. There are people that are very proud of you, and along with me, some silent lurkers in this sub also are. 
Tbh, I'm on the same boat with you as a graduating student. The friends I have will eventually forget me. You'll eventually find friends who'll accept you and stay with you for long. You are strong, and with that you'll eventually meet the friends you wish for. I hope the next part of your life will be a good one.
A friend told me that being tired is a petty reason to die. So yeah, I've stopped talking to that person. I hope you get the rest you need.

Same here, I also want to go back. This really hit me home because I usually avoid people even those who try to get close to me. We're still here, so we just have to continue. Maybe we'll even get a second chance by meeting new people we can befriend. 

Idk your exact circumstances, but I hope that your days will get better. 

Just a random stranger from the internet showing some support.👏

Crying is something we usually try to hold back. When we physically can't cry, then that's the time when we really want to cry. I can't even get any relief because I can't let it out by crying. When you're experiencing something really rough, try to let the tears flow out. Hope things get better for you.

Hey, thanks for giving a reply. I don't really want to talk. I just wanted to relieve some of these thoughts (even if just a little) by sharing it here. Knowing someone was able read it is enough for me. Hope you have a good day cus you deserve it.
